replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: To solve a second-order algebraic equation, we need to isolate the variable by applying the quadratic formula. We can then substitute the values of a, b, and c into the formula to obtain the final solution.

To find the stationary points of an equation y=f(x), we need to take the derivative of the function with respect to x. This will give us the slope of the tangent line at each point.
